conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: An open wound weakens force and endurance. Strength -1 and Grit -1 until the bleeding is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Sprained Joint
conditions.description: Pain makes quick movement unreliable. Agility -2 until the injury is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Infection
conditions.description: An untreated wound drains endurance and confidence. Grit -2 and Presence -1 until the infection is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Fever
conditions.description: Heat and confusion cloud judgment. Wits -2 and Grit -1 until the fever is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Shaken
conditions.description: Fear interrupts clear thought and confident speech. Wits -1 and Presence -1 until Shaken is removed.

conditions.name: Concussed
conditions.description: Pain and poor balance slow thought and movement. Wits -2 and Agility -1 until the concussion is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Burned
conditions.description: Raw skin makes every effort harder to endure. Grit -2 until the burn is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Irradiated
conditions.description: Nausea and weakness reduce physical power and endurance. Strength -1 and Grit -2 until the condition is treated or removed.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.description: Your depleted body struggles to act or think. Strength -1, Agility -1, and Wits -1 until Exhausted is removed.

conditions.name: Gutrot
conditions.description: Mutant filth churns in your gut and sours every effort. Strength -2 and Grit -1 until the rot is purged.

conditions.name: Spore Cough
conditions.description: Pale spores rasp in your lungs and scatter your focus. Agility -1 and Wits -1 until the spores are purged.

conditions.name: Mind Static
conditions.description: A mutant scream still rings behind your thoughts. Wits -2 and Presence -1 until the static is cleansed.

conditions.name: Inspired
conditions.description: Fresh purpose strengthens your influence. Presence +2 for the next two checked choices.

conditions.name: Focused
conditions.description: Each problem separates into manageable pieces. Wits +2 for the next two checked choices.

conditions.name: Steady Hands
conditions.description: Controlled breath steadies precise movement. Agility +2 for the next two checked choices.

conditions.name: Momentum
conditions.description: Moving before comfort dulls your attention grants a brief edge. Every stat gains +1 for the next checked choice.

conditions.name: Adrenaline
conditions.description: Harvested mutant glands set your blood on fire. Strength +2 for the next two checked choices.

conditions.name: Bloodlust
conditions.description: The taste of a hard kill sharpens every strike. Strength +1 and Agility +1 for the next two checked choices.

conditions.name: Iron Will
conditions.description: A sworn vow steadies your body against pain. Grit +2 for the next two checked choices.
